newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha quiet, prompt overhang continues.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha quiet, prompt overhang continues.

text.p: NWE naphtha markets remained in the doldrums on Tuesday with most traders away from their offices and brokers said prices were notionally unchanged to lower.
"There really is no market at all. The buyers are not there and the sellers are holding back trying to keep prices from falling," one said.

Traders said good ARA fob availabilities were putting pressure on the market. There was no buying interest from the petrochemical market, most of whom were heard to be fully stocked-up until mid-January at the earliest.
